title: premna henryana
intro: Premna henryana, commonly known as Henry's ironwood, is a plant species belonging to the family Lamiaceae. It has been traditionally used in medicine due to its health benefits, such as its ability to treat fever, diarrhea, and various infections. The therapeutic actions of Premna henryana include its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which can help soothe and protect the body from harm. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and contribute to its therapeutic effects.
